moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio e-glide, written here): cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1) (the older Material standard), 300 ms (site motion_ms). Gentle; near text and for UI explanations, a premium default. Writable now as custom(M0,0 C .4,0 .2,1 1,1); proposed alias glide. Site demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.3 s) · ease (custom .4,0,.2,1).
